messages:
Rina: starting thread for AuroraBank POC. Requirements: streaming SDK, structured transaction output, EU data residency, customer KMS, and an initial cost estimate.
Omar: noted. EU-only -> likely Dedicated with VPC peering or Private deployment. Legal will need KMS key-handling diagram.
Devon: integration notes: streaming via websocket, prefer ephemeral tokens for long-lived clients. quick sample:
```
# node ws example
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=redwood-4b', {
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${EPHEMERAL_TOKEN}`, 'X-Region': 'eu-west-1' }
});
```
Kira: they want structured JSON output for tx parsing. schema draft: {"id": string, "amount": number, "merchant": {"id": string, "name": string}}. we'll show function-calling fallback to improve robustness.
FinanceBot: rough pricing: 8-GPU reserved pool in eu ~ $Zk/mo at committed utilization; add ~20% for cross-region failover. need qps and tokens/day to finalize.
SecurityBot: SOC2 docs available internally. customer KMS supported via key-wrap. open ticket SEC-590 for KMS integration diagrams. EU-only processing may require Private deployment.
Rina: action items: Omar = infra/legal loop for deployment option, Devon = sample harness + quant eval plan, FinanceBot = draft quote, Kira = schema + function-call examples. Will schedule 30m sync after we collect prompt set.
Devon: will request sample prompts and expected correctness metric from AuroraBank.
Rina: thanks — ping this thread when items are ready. :thumbsup:
